verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 7 remains correct, sound, and complete. The shared PLAN_GENERATED_AT grammar gates both whole-plan validation and review ordering before empty or singleton queues can short-circuit. Dispatch validates the complete plan before any mutation and obtains review work through review_service_queue(plan, repo), which exact-partitions by repository, performs a deterministic pure rotation, preserves every admitted row, and does not cross policy boundaries. The probabilistic fairness claim is accurately qualified and makes no bounded-wait promise. The tests independently pin malformed-input refusal, exact offsets, rotation shape, totality, reproducibility, caller non-mutation, repository isolation, the live dispatch binding and both arguments, and non-vacuity against representative permissive call-site mutations. I found no correctness, trust-boundary, security, or test-validity issue. Round 6 also had no findings, so progress is stagnant under the required rubric while approval remains warranted.
